images.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an original premium Korean financial editorial cover, wide 1200x630 ratio. A vivid realistic 3D paper-engineering installation: two bright folded receipt ribbons labeled exactly '원금' and '이자' converge into a single elegant circular translucent teal lens engraved '40%'. A small silver apartment key anchors the foreground; fine paper grain and precise physical shadows. Clean pale gray-white studio backdrop, teal, vermilion and charcoal palette, sophisticated analytical design, no people, no coins. Large perfect Korean typography, exact main headline '전세대출 소득공제', exact secondary formula '(원금 + 이자) × 40%', exact small readable qualifier '청약저축과 합산 한도 확인'. Composition is a full cover, not a web UI, magazine-caliber graphic with dramatic tactile detail. All important Korean text and objects inside central 84% safe zone with generous edge margins, readable at thumbnail size. Avoid money showers, fake bank logos, platform labels, watermark, microtext and any refund guarantee. Brand new concept, not a house diorama or split app screenshot.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a brand-new square 1080x1080 Korean tax blog cover: a punchy high-fashion surreal 3D typography poster with a giant torn chrome-and-white receipt curling upward through a luminous coral-red physical ring. The receipt is stamped exactly '원금', and a smaller translucent ice-blue tab is stamped exactly '이자'. Rich warm red studio backdrop with cream white and silver, crisp directional shadows, premium CGI material quality, no house model, no people and no money shower. Main exact oversized Korean headline in the upper-middle safe area on two lines: '전세대출 갚은 돈' / '원금도 공제?'. Bottom exact prominent number line '상환액의 40%' with exact readable qualifier below it '요건 충족 시 · 환급액 아님'. Do not add ANY other text. Keep the entire headline and these three lines inside central84% of the square, generous readable margin and strong mobile hook. The amount is an income deduction, not a guaranteed refund. No platform labels, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra microtext. Visually very different from a pale white-and-teal informational calculator cover.

Sunny window lighting, detailed tactile corrugated cardboard and crisp paper, fresh white walls, warm natural wood as a small accent only, cheerful everyday mood. Integrate a strong legible Korean headline into uncluttered upper-central negative space on exactly two lines '전세대출 갚은 돈' / '연말정산에 넣을까요?'. Large charcoal text with a tasteful red marker emphasis, NOT on an explanatory UI card. Use only those specified text labels and headline, no extra tiny writing.
